name: Ballin Simple
author: ryan123zone

sections.description:
Ballin Simple is an athletic kit customizer plugin for WooCommerce. It allows your customers to personalize jerseys, apparel, and merchandise with their custom Name and Number directly on the product detail page.

Key Features

  • Custom Name & Number Add-ons: Allow customers to type their custom name and jersey number with optional flat add-on fees.
  • Interactive Live Preview: Real-time visual overlay on product images (front and back views).
  • Draggable Text Layers: Customers can adjust and fine-tune the exact positioning of their name and number.
  • Multiple Athletic Fonts: Support for popular sports and athletic typefaces (Teko, Bebas Neue, Outfit, Anton).
  • Seamless WooCommerce Flow: Custom choices and dynamic add-on pricing flow directly through Cart, Checkout, Order emails, and Admin order management.
  • High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) Ready: Full compatibility with WooCommerce Custom Order Tables (HPOS).
  • Per-Product Overrides: Configure default customization settings globally or override add-on pricing and preview images per product.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the ballin-simple folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install the ZIP file via Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > Kit Customizer to configure global personalization settings, default add-on pricing, and live preview options.
  4. (Optional) Edit individual products to upload custom Front/Back view images or override pricing.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes, Ballin Simple requires WooCommerce 5.0 or higher to be installed and active.

Is High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) supported?

Yes, Ballin Simple declares full compatibility with WooCommerce HPOS (Custom Order Tables).

Where are the customer customization details saved?

Custom Name, Number, chosen font style, and generated preview mockups are saved directly in the WooCommerce Order Line Item metadata, visible in both the customer’s order confirmation and the store admin.
